verdict.rationale: Docs describe the Nix store as a shared content-addressable location where multiple package versions coexist and are built/downloaded once, with binary caching reusing built artifacts across users, plus community corroboration of shared builds cutting dev team time by reusing artifacts across devs, CI, and deployment. Minor gap: missing for 10: explicit first-party statement of cross-project dedup at scale beyond store mechanics/binary cache.
